title: MSA/DPA Redline Concierge: Triage, Cost Estimation, and Sales Pre-clearance Workflow
creator: Marisol Vega
description:
Goal: Build a deterministic workflow (the 'Redline Concierge') that routes incoming MSA/DPA redlines through an integrated triage + pricing impact estimator, surfaces a short recommendation to sales within 48 hours, and records a disposition that informs downstream billing and indemnity calculations.

Scope:
- Intake normalization for redline artifacts (PDF, Word, and encoded SSQ exports)
- Automated clause classifier that tags common deviations (indemnity, liability cap, escrow, data residency, subprocessors)
- Lightweight pricing impact model that maps clause severity to estimated pricing delta bands (+0%, +5-15%, +15-50%, manual review)
- Sales pre-clearance UI flow for quick accept/decline/redirect with templated counterproposal text and auto-populated PRD fields for legal follow-up
- Audit trail and signals for billing/quote lock adjustments and A/B telemetry on downstream deal conversion

Out of scope for initial rollout: full SSQ auto-complete, automated legal language rewriting, and machine-signature execution. Those are follow-ups.

Acceptance criteria:
1) Mean time to first-recommendation <= 48 hours for 90% of incoming redlines in pilot accounts.
2) Classifier precision >= 85% on indemnity/liability and >= 75% on subprocessors in manual evaluation set.
3) Pricing impact band assignment accuracy >= 70% against historical negotiated concessions.
4) Sales pre-clearance flow used on >= 60% of pilot redlines and reduces legal queue escalations by 30% in pilot.

Deliverables:
- Intake connector and normalizer (PRD + integration spec)
- Clause classifier v0 and evaluation harness
- Pricing impact model (rule-based + ML signal) and band definitions doc
- Sales pre-clearance UI mockups and Console API endpoints
- Telemetry dashboard and pilot runbook

Risks & mitigation:
- Incorrect pricing bands could bias sales behavior: run shadow evaluation and require manual confirm before quote lock.
- Classifier false negatives on high-risk clauses: add mandatory human QA for clauses flagged but low classifier confidence.
- Legal/Compliance pushback on automated recommendations: keep recommendation advisory; all accepted counterproposals must pass human sign-off for P0/P1 deviations.
